anybody.meaning_zh: 任何人（口语，多用于疑问/否定）
anybody.example_en: Is anybody at home right now?

anyone.meaning_zh: 任何人（较正式，也可用在肯定句）
anyone.example_en: Anyone can join the school club.
anyone.example_zh: 任何人都可以加入学校社团。

somebody.example_en: Somebody left a note on my desk.
somebody.example_zh: 有人在我课桌上留了一张纸条。

someone.example_en: Someone is waiting for you at the gate.

everybody.example_zh: 每个人都很喜欢这次班级聚会。

everyone.example_en: Everyone must bring a pencil tomorrow.
everyone.example_zh: 每个人明天都必须带一支铅笔。

their.example_en: Their house is next to the park.
their.example_zh: 他们的房子在公园旁边。

theirs.meaning_zh: 他们的（单独使用，不加名词）
theirs.example_en: Those bags are theirs, not ours.
theirs.example_zh: 那些包是他们的，不是我们的。

them.example_en: I saw them at the sports centre.
them.example_zh: 我在体育中心看见他们了。

our.example_en: Our classroom is on the second floor.

many.meaning_zh: 许多（后接可数名词复数）
many.example_en: Many students joined the sports club.
many.example_zh: 许多学生加入了体育俱乐部。

lot.example_en: We had a lot of fun at the park.
lot.example_zh: 我们在公园玩得很开心。

pretty.example_en: The maths quiz was pretty easy.
pretty.example_zh: 这次数学小测相当容易。

quite.example_en: It was quite cold on the morning bus.
quite.example_zh: 早上坐公交时天气相当冷。

worthy.example_en: The cause is worthy of support.

exit.example_en: The exit is at the back of the hall.

export.example_en: The region will export tea this year.
export.example_zh: 这个地区今年将出口茶叶。

actually.example_en: I actually finished my homework before dinner.
actually.example_zh: 我实际上在晚饭前就做完了作业。

bathroom.example_en: The bathroom is upstairs next to my bedroom.
bathroom.example_zh: 浴室在楼上，紧挨着我的卧室。

bedroom.example_en: My bedroom faces the school playground.
bedroom.example_zh: 我的卧室正对学校操场。

beside.example_en: Please sit beside me at the front desk.

together.example_en: We study English together after school.
together.example_zh: 我们放学后一起学英语。

admire.example_en: I really admire my grandmother for her patience.
admire.example_zh: 我真的很钦佩奶奶的耐心。

after.example_en: We play football after school every day.
after.example_zh: 我们每天放学后踢足球。

again.example_en: Please say that new word again more slowly.
again.example_zh: 请把那个生词再慢一点说一遍。

ago.example_en: We met two years ago at the school fair.
ago.example_zh: 我们两年前在学校游园会上认识。

ahead.example_en: The library is just ahead on the left.

always.example_en: She always arrives on time for morning class.
always.example_zh: 她早上上课总是准时到。

back.example_en: Please come back before dinner tonight.

background.example_en: Tell me about your family background in a few sentences.
background.example_zh: 用几句话介绍一下你的家庭背景。

mine.meaning_zh: 我的（单独使用，不加名词）

till.example_en: The bakery stays open till six on Saturday evenings.
till.example_zh: 这家面包店周六晚上一直开到六点。

whilst.example_en: Please stay quiet whilst the baby is sleeping.
whilst.example_zh: 宝宝睡觉时请保持安静。

shop.example_en: That corner shop sells bread, milk, and cheap pens.
shop.example_zh: 拐角那家商店卖面包、牛奶和便宜的笔。

store.example_en: I bought eggs at the store before it closed.
store.example_zh: 商店关门之前，我买了鸡蛋。

perform.example_en: The drama club will perform a short play on Friday.
perform.example_zh: 戏剧社星期五将表演一个短剧。

amusement.example_en: We spent the afternoon at the amusement park.
amusement.example_zh: 我们在游乐园里度过了那个下午。

story.example_en: Grandma's story about the lost dog made us laugh.
story.example_zh: 奶奶讲的那只走失小狗的故事把我们逗笑了。

tale.example_en: Dad's tale about a brave mouse lasted until bedtime.
tale.example_zh: 爸爸讲的勇敢小老鼠的故事一直讲到睡觉。

ad.example_en: I saw an ad for cheap trainers in the shop window.
ad.example_zh: 我在商店橱窗里看到一则便宜运动鞋的广告。

occupation.example_en: Nursing became her occupation after years of hospital work.
occupation.example_zh: 在医院工作多年以后，护理成了她的职业。

profession.example_en: Teaching is the profession she chose after college.
profession.example_zh: 教书是她大学毕业后选择的职业。

bicycle.example_en: I ride my bicycle to school when the weather is fine.
bicycle.example_zh: 天气好的时候，我骑自行车去上学。

bike.example_en: His new bike has a bright red basket.
bike.example_zh: 他的新自行车上装着一个鲜红的车筐。

protect.example_en: Thick coats protect us from the wind at the bus stop.
protect.example_zh: 在公交车站，厚外套保护我们免受风吹。

protection.example_en: Sunscreen gives protection on a bright sports afternoon.
protection.example_zh: 晴朗的运动日下午，防晒霜能提供保护。

completely.example_zh: 我把作业忘得干干净净。

fine.example_en: The weather stayed fine, so our picnic blankets remained outside.
fine.example_zh: 天气一直很好，所以我们的野餐垫就留在外面。
